description.zh: 是否解除资源绑定的全部标签。TagKey.N为空时，该参数有效。默认值为**false**。
description.en: Specifies whether to detach all tags from the resource. This parameter takes effect when TagKey.N is empty. The default value is **false**.
The region ID of the resource.
The IDs of resources from which you want to detach tags.

description.zh:
资源类型。枚举类型，目前支持的资源类型：
- **INSTANCE**

- **TOPIC**

- **CONSUMERGROUP**

> 不区分大小写。
description.en:
The resource type. Enumeration type, currently supported resource types:

- **INSTANCE**

- **TOPIC**

- **CONSUMERGROUP**

> Case-insensitive.
The tag keys of the resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alikafka untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --all false --resource-id alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs20000 --tag-key FinanceDept --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alikafka UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs20000' --TagKey.1 FinanceDept --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
